items.excerpt: The $849 Mori is designed to respond to your environment, knowing when to play and when to stay quiet.

items.excerpt: What started off as a dare became a fully fledged app in less than a day

items.title: Lawsuits Allege Delivery Robots Recorded Biometric Data Without Permission
items.excerpt: As delivery robots roll through cities like Chicago, they're fueling fears about unregulated surveillance in public spaces.

items.title: Pages, Keynote, Numbers just added powerful new AI features
items.excerpt: Apple is rolling out AI-centric updates to its iWork suite—Pages, Keynote, Numbers—that include a brand new ‘Intelligent Assistant.’

items.title: Baseus’ New Security Camera Keeps Intruders in the Spotlight
items.excerpt: The Baseus PrimeSentinel U2 Pro's motorized spotlight focuses on deterrence by following people as they move outside your home.

items.title: Ditch the data center: I fired my cloud chatbot and built a free local AI agent to run on my PC — and you can too
items.excerpt: Tom's Guide walks through replacing a cloud chatbot with a free, locally run AI agent on a home PC, covering the hardware, models and setup needed to keep AI work entirely on-device.

items.title: AMD's FSR 4.1 now works on Radeon RX 6000 GPUs, Xbox Series X and S, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9, and Z2 SoCs — new release brings cutting-edge tech to older hardware with a small performance cost
items.excerpt: AMD gives older GPUs an image quality boost amid the ongoing AI chip drought

items.title: Windows 98 SE users get a Thunderbolt 4 driver, thanks to AI assistance — vibe-coded xHCI98 driver works in Microsoft OSes up to Windows 7
items.excerpt: If you've ever wanted to run Windows 98 SE on your mid-2010s or newer PC with fast USB hub support, here's your chance.

items.title: AMD and Intel will work together to create a single PyTorch code path for AI inference on CPUs — x86 rivals fold AMD ZenDNN library into Intel oneDNN to make CPU AI simpler
items.excerpt: AMD has also joined the UXL Foundation as a steering member.

items.title: Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreak breakthrough shows what AI can do, but it’s not a one-click hack
items.excerpt: The Nintendo Switch 2 has reportedly been jailbroken with help from OpenAI's Codex, opening the door to homebrew and game modding, but limitations remain.

items.title: Meta Expands SDKs To Boost Spatial Apps On Quest & VR Glasses, Including NBA, Disney+
items.excerpt: Meta announced new SDKs for spatial apps on Quest and its VR/AI glasses, including a VR Layout SDK it says is optimized to be implemented by an AI coding agent, alongside NBA and Disney+ spatial updates.

items.title: The real reason to care about Vivo's latest phone is the camera [Gallery]
items.excerpt: Vivo's AI Creation camera mode isn't just for flagship phones anymore, thanks to the Vivo V80's affordable price.

items.title: New AMD Ryzen AI HX 400 series processor leaks with 16-CU GPU
items.excerpt: The Ryzen AI 400 series of processors includes only two HX variants for now, and they are both in the Ryzen AI 9 category. A new leak has suggested that a Ryzen AI 7-series HX processor might be on the way.

items.title: XREAL Announces '1 Pro+' Flagship AR Glasses, Now Available & Priced at $599
items.excerpt: XREAL launched the $599 1 Pro+ AR glasses, a refresh of its One Pro that raises peak brightness to 1,200 nits and adds AI-driven HDR (AI HDR) and faster 2D-to-3D conversion.

items.title: Birdbuddy’s Nook is a compact smart bird feeder for small spaces and budgets
items.excerpt: The Birdbuddy Nook makes smart feeders more accessible to novice bird-watchers.

items.title: HomePod Mini 2 (2026) vs. HomePod Mini (2020): Is Siri AI worth the upgrade?
items.excerpt: There are a few notable upgrades, including Siri AI support, but your original HomePod Mini may still do almost everything you need.

items.title: Apple TV 4K (2026) vs Apple TV 4K (2022): Is ‘Hey Siri’ worth twice the price?
items.excerpt: The new Apple TV 4K costs twice as much as the previous model, but is it worth the price?

items.title: I changed one llama.cpp flag, and my 8GB laptop GPU now runs a 35B model faster than I can read
items.excerpt: XDA shows how offloading mixture-of-experts layers to system RAM with a single llama.cpp flag lets an 8GB laptop GPU run a 35B local LLM faster than reading speed.

items.title: Bug turns one of the biggest fears about Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses into reality
items.excerpt: A bug caused Ray-Ban Meta glasses to save audio recordings and transcripts of conversations to the Meta AI app without wearers saying 'Hey Meta'; Meta says it is fixed, but privacy concerns remain.

items.title: Amazon Prime comes with an Alexa upgrade you should know about
items.excerpt: Alexa+ is now free for all Amazon Prime members, and they can access the upgrade via their Echo Show and Dot devices, their tablets, the app and on the web.

items.title: Meet Mori, a Cute Robot Mushroom That Doesn’t Really Say (or Do) Anything
items.excerpt: Step one in convincing people to live with robots with cameras on their faces? Disguise them as cute home decor.
